gen-dafont-arkhip-space-grotesk: Arkhip spaces its letters far apart, with no thick-and-thin shift anywhere. Space Grotesk draws its glyphs as one constant-width ribbon with breathing counters, so the two feel like cousins, one shouting and one chatting.
gen-dafont-azonix-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Azonix is wide-mouthed and crisp, with capitals barely above its lowercase. Pilcrow Rounded then runs paragraphs warm and close, its tight letter spacing and big counters keeping text soft instead of stiff.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-fs-nunito: Bushcraft spaces its characters extra wide, with no weight shift along any curve. Nunito reads like a friendly murmur down a full page, its round bowls and terminals stopping short of the stem keeping things approachable.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-nunito: Nunito is all round bowls and terminals that stop short of the stem. Capture It pushes back with nearly sealed letters and a towering x-height, so the heading feels shut tight while the text breathes.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-hind: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz fills out its lowercase to a big body. Hind lays down plain strokes of constant ink, its c endings never curling inward, so the loud heading gets a quiet, steady partner.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-quicksand: Capture Smallz is raw and tactical, with big-bodied lowercase letters. Quicksand flows across a full paragraph on bar thickness that never changes, its tall bulb-like bowls keeping the text light and approachable.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-familjen-grotesk: Wide and geometric, Conthrax packs tall lowercase beneath barely taller capitals, while Familjen Grotesk adds lively, half-finished bowls beside it. Conthrax earns its keep when it runs big and brief.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-quicksand: A wide mouth on the lowercase a marks Conthrax, whose tall bodies leave capitals barely taller; Quicksand brings round, bulb-like bowls. Long paragraphs glide past lightly on its uniform bars.
gen-dafont-cowboys-fs-synonym: Big gaps between neighboring stems give Cowboys a rustic, laser-etched look, drawn in a trace that never changes width. Synonym's open curves and constant ink supply the dependable steadiness underneath.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-fs-pilcrow-roun: Early GameBoy stretches its tracking out wide, with a modest thick-thin difference and a skyward x-height. Pilcrow Rounded tucks in warm, tight text, its big counters softening the shouting.
